Name: Lunar Precision
Base Effect: If your die is lower than the opponent’s, add +1.
Wager Bonus: If you win the wager, add an extra +1.
Flavour Text: “The moon lifts those who fall behind.”

Name: Star‑Tilt Blessing
Base Effect: If your die is equal to the opponent’s, gain +2.
Wager Bonus: If you lose the wager, you may reroll your die.
Flavour Text: “When stars align, destiny leans your way.”
